decisions.reason: A coupling protection cap is a simple accessory tied directly to the firm's trailer know-how; it costs little to keep, though as a minor item it carries some risk of being quietly delisted.
The box trailer line is the firm's core product area, where its production knowledge lets it interpret results and keep improving, and it was featured on the home page.
Car transporter trailers build on existing trailer chassis and production know-how, so the firm can assimilate market feedback, though the segment is somewhat more specialised.
The low-bed trailer series is close to the firm's established knowledge base and was prominently shown, which supports continued refinement.
High covers are a related accessory line for its own trailers that complements the core range and draws on existing know-how.
A further box trailer series lies squarely within the firm's core competence, although some overlap with Product B could prompt later consolidation.
